title: 第731章 大军至谁包围谁第730章 送走了不能走
slug: 玄幻真龙为骨我刀问天下
content_zh:
李飞仙站在他身旁，手中飞剑嗡嗡作响，看着那一尊尊四境大妖，一脸兴奋道：
“确实不少！”
慕容雪眉头微微皱起，淡黄色眸子捕捉到了那几尊五境大妖，腰间的细长飞剑发出了一声轻吟，声音顿时一沉：“六尊五境大妖，妖族的底蕴还真是雄厚。”
词大家南宫争渡朱唇轻启，顺势接过了话茬：“是啊，不仅大妖多，那些妖卒也多，少说都有十万。”
“不止，妖气冲天而起，遮天蔽日，最起码都有二十万余。”
一直沉默不语的南岳正神江慕白一脸凝重的说道。
猴子自己的藏器中取出牛头傩面，话音轻快道：“十万也好，二十万也罢，今日来多少我们都得顶住。”
陆去疾给了猴子一个欣赏的眼神，旋即应声道：“猴子说得对，来多少我们都得顶住，只有把它们打疼了，打怕了，它们才会对着妖庭求援。”
慕容雪握紧手中长剑，凭空跨出一步，道：“我一人可杀一尊五境大妖。”
词大家南宫争渡、诗大家墨东晟、赋大家李兴付三位大家对视了一眼，而后齐声喝道：“我们可杀三尊五境大妖！”
南岳正神江慕白挥了挥袖子，不甘示弱道：“我亦可杀一尊五境大妖，最不济也能以命换命。”
长白门前一代圣女连瑶娇躯一扭，酥声道：“我不擅杀伐，但手段尽出的话也可拿下一尊五境大妖。”
陆去疾看着争先恐后的六人，佯装可惜道：“一共就六尊五境大妖都被你们几人分完了，那我只能勉为其难的收拾那些四境了。”
二戒摸了摸自己的大光头，咂了咂舌：
“谁说不是呢，我还想挑战一把呢。”
江慕白来了兴致，笑着打断道：“是嘛？要不咱俩换换？”
二戒连忙摆手：“可别啊，你是大雨大名鼎鼎的南岳正神，我是谁啊？一个夜宿花魁的酒肉和尚，哪能打得过五境大妖啊？还是你上吧。”
听到这一番话，众人顿时哈哈大笑。
笑声轻快，直入云霄，充斥着一股子豪气，引得云层低垂百丈，狂风呜咽千里，写尽了江湖意气。
一盏茶的功夫不到，妖族二十万余大军浩浩荡荡的兵临云深城。

六尊五境大妖，二十几尊四境大妖一字排开，屹立在半空。
看到云深城内那座血淋淋的京观，这些大妖瞬间勃然大怒。
从来没有人族修士敢在万妖谷内铸起千丈京观，从来没有！
就算是三千年的诗剑双绝也没有做出过这么深恶痛绝的事！
这无异于把妖族的脸踩在脚下，还尿上一泡。
“气煞我也！”
一个头顶龙角，身披黄金甲的五境大妖往前跨出一步，吹胡子瞪眼的盯着矗立在云深城头十六道身影，怒不可遏道：
“尔等真是好大的胆子！敢在云深城内铸起京观，今日不杀了你们，我等誓不为妖！”
站在城头的陆去疾只觉这话有些刺耳，伸手掏了掏耳朵后，一脸不屑道：
“聒噪。”
“有本事就来。”
“你和它们废什么话？”李飞仙手腕微微一用力，手中飞剑太常仙直指对面的一众大妖，罕见爆了粗口：“干你娘！少tm废话，速来领死！”
猴子、大傻、黄朝笙、老王四人盯着李飞仙，不由得感觉到了陌生。
这还是那个李飞仙吗？怎么变得这么彪悍了。
content_en:
Li Feixian stood beside him, the flying sword in his hand buzzing, looking at the great monster of the four realms, and said with excitement:
"It's indeed quite a lot!"
Murong Xue frowned slightly, her pale yellow eyes captured those five great monsters. The slender flying sword on her waist let out a soft groan, and her voice suddenly sank: "Six great five-level monsters, the demon clan's heritage is really strong."
The poet, Nangong Zhengdu, opened his lips lightly and took over the conversation: "Yes, not only are there many big demons, but there are also many demon soldiers, at least a hundred thousand."
"More than that, the demonic energy soared into the sky, covering the sky and the sun. At least there were more than 200,000 of them."
Nanyue Zhengshen Jiang Mubai, who had been silent all this time, said with a solemn expression.
Monkey took out the Niutou Nuo noodles from his own possession and said in a brisk voice: "Whether it's one hundred thousand or two hundred thousand, we have to withstand whatever comes today."
Lu Quji gave the monkey an appreciative look, and immediately responded: "The monkey is right, we have to resist no matter how much they come. Only when they hurt and frighten them will they ask for help from the Demon Court."
Murong Xue clenched the sword in her hand, took a step out of thin air, and said: "I can kill a five-level demon by myself."
The three masters of poetry, Nangong Zhengdu, the master of poetry, Mo Dongsheng, and the master of poetry, Li Xingfu, looked at each other, and then shouted in unison: "We can kill three great demons of the five realms!"
Jiang Mubai, the righteous god of Nanyue, waved his sleeves and said, not to be outdone, "I can also kill a great demon of the fifth realm, and at the worst, I can exchange my life for my life."
Lian Yao, the saint of the generation in front of the Changbai Gate, twisted her delicate body and said in a crisp voice: "I'm not good at killing, but if I use all my means, I can capture a five-level demon."
Lu Quji looked at the six people scrambling for the first place, and pretended to be regretful and said: "A total of six great demons of the five realms have been divided by you, so I can only deal with those of the four realms reluctantly."
Erjie touched his bald head and clicked his tongue:
"Who says it's not the case? I still want to challenge it."
Jiang Mubai became interested and interrupted with a smile: "Really? How about we switch?"
Erjie waved his hands quickly: "Don't say goodbye. You are the famous Nanyue Zhengshen in Heavy Rain. Who am I? How can a meat-and-wine monk who spends the night with an oiran beat the Great Demon of the Five Realms? It's better for you to do it."
Hearing these words, everyone burst out laughing.
The laughter was brisk and went straight into the sky, full of heroic spirit, causing the clouds to droop hundreds of feet, and the strong wind to howl for thousands of miles, which filled the world with the spirit of the world.
In less than a cup of tea, more than 200,000 demon clan troops arrived at Yunshen City in mighty force.
Six great demons of the fifth realm and more than twenty great demons of the fourth realm were lined up in a row, standing in the air.
Seeing the bloody Jingguan in Yunshen City, these big demons instantly became furious.
No human monk has ever dared to build a thousand-foot-long Jingguan in the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons, never!
Even in three thousand years of poetry and swordsmanship, he has never done something so abhorrent!
This is tantamount to stepping on the face of the demon clan and making him urinate.
"I'm so angry!"
A five-level demon with dragon horns on its head and golden armor took a step forward, blowing his beard and staring at the sixteen figures standing at the top of Yunshen City, and said angrily:
"You are so brave! You dare to build a Jingguan in Yunshen City. If I don't kill you today, we swear not to be monsters!"
Lu Quji, who was standing at the top of the city, felt that these words were a bit harsh. He reached out and dug behind his ears and said with disdain:
"Noisy."
"Come if you can."
"What nonsense are you talking to them about?" Li Feixian exerted a slight force on his wrist, and pointed the flying sword Taichangxian directly at the big demons opposite him, and uttered a rare curse word: "Fuck your mother! Stop talking nonsense, come and kill me!"
Monkey, Dasha, Huang Chaosheng, and Lao Wang stared at Li Feixian and couldn't help but feel strange.
Is this still the same Li Feixian? Why have you become so tough?
